video_title: “We Stuck To The Game Plan And Matched OKC's Intensity.” | Chris Finch Postgame Sound | 11.25.26

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on Minnesota's defensive adjustments against OKC
quotes.excerpt: We got a lot better against the switching. The switching in the first half bothered us.
quotes.quote: Regardless of who they have or don't have, it's a really well-coached team. They make you beat them. We got a lot better against the switching. The switching in the first half bothered us, when they went to that second unit. We were much better against it in the second half, certainly down the stretch too. There were some game plan mistakes early. Once we corrected those and were much more on point, made a few adjustments, then guys were able to settle into a rhythm of guarding a bit. They missed some timely shots too, so that helped us.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch on the adjustments that helped the Timberwolves beat OKC: We got a lot better against the switching in the second half and were much more on point with our game plan.

structured.context: Chris Finch discusses the team's defensive adjustments and performance against the Oklahoma City Thunder following the game.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on Jaden McDaniels' emergence as a reliable player
quotes.excerpt: He's got a great touch, great size. Takes his time, makes the right play.
quotes.quote: He's got a great touch, great size. Takes his time, makes the right play. Whether it's to the corner, whether it's to Rudy, or whether it's for himself, he can make all the plays. He and D'Angelo have a really good chemistry, of course.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch on Jaden McDaniels: He has great touch and size, and he is making the right plays whether it is to the corner, to Rudy, or for himself.

structured.context: Chris Finch praises Jaden McDaniels for his decision-making and chemistry with his teammates.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on Jaden McDaniels' complete game against OKC
quotes.excerpt: Complete game on both ends of the floor. Having the energy to be able to score.
quotes.quote: Complete game on both ends of the floor. Having the energy to be able to score like that and also score on demand after guarding Shai. We matched his minutes exclusively. We didn't really give him much of a break, and just to be able to guard and score was huge.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch praised Jaden McDaniels for a complete game against OKC: Having the energy to score on demand after guarding Shai and matching his minutes exclusively was huge.

structured.context: Chris Finch highlights Jaden McDaniels' defensive effort against Shai Gilgeous-Alexander while maintaining offensive production.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on adjusting the rotation if Jaden McDaniels is out
quotes.excerpt: We're going to have to figure out who we put in the starting lineup.
quotes.quote: We're going to have to figure out who we put in the starting lineup. Activate our two-ways at this point and try to soldier on, figure out how to tweak things here. Right now I don't have any answers for you.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch on potential rotation changes if Jaden McDaniels is out: We will have to figure out who to put in the starting lineup and activate our two-ways. Right now I do not have any answers.

structured.context: Chris Finch addresses potential rotation changes and lineup adjustments if Jaden McDaniels is unavailable for future games.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on the team's ability to handle adversity
quotes.excerpt: They're pretty even-keeled, generally as people they're pretty even-keeled, they stay pretty focused.
quotes.quote: They're pretty even-keeled, generally as people they're pretty even-keeled, they stay pretty focused.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch on the team's mindset: They are pretty even-keeled as people and they stay pretty focused.
